3240-6462-8250-8347.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

586-678-997.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

3430-4824-6723.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

643-2438-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-2438-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat from step 3.

5170-6132-6495-8175.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
5170-6132-6495-8175.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-5254-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
728-5254-6627.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

539-4687-5115.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
539-4687-5115.description:
Activate Ashaya by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

2557-4365-4772-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
2557-4365-4772-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1479-5233-7893.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-3384.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Wizard Class triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

261-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
261-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

6797-7083-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Baloth Prime trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Baloth Prime trigger, untapping it and creating a tapped 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3705-4050-5997-6967.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

359-813-957.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns.
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each other turn.
359-813-957.notes: If desired, you can do steps 2 and 3 during the first extra turn instead to spread out the mana costs.

341-2866-3689-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

144-5434-5686.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 greater than the largest life total among your opponents.
144-5434-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, its first ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Yarus' second ability triggers, returning Ashcloud Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield face down, and then turning it face up.
Ashcloud Phoenix's second ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each player.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

1228-2034-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-2034-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

656-5113-5220.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Ugin's Conjurant on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1218-1932-5064.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Goblins.
1218-1932-5064.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Skirk Fire Marshal +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five Goblins you control, putting ten -1/-1 counters on each creature opponents control and giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters.

283-1283-3581-3996.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Twilight Drover.
Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
283-1283-3581-3996.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {3} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Illusionists's Bracers triggers, copying Twilight Drover's ability.
Resolve both Twilight Drover abilities, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Kykar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {3}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

914-1354-2635-3337.notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least nine artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1354-2635-3337.description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{G}{G}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving Reflection of Kiki-Jiki +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Repeat.

553-1403-2235-3212.description:
Move to your draw step, drawing Approach of the Second Sun and revealing it due to God-Eternal Kefnet's ability.
Resolve God-Eternal Kefnet's trigger, copying Approach of the Second Sun and casting the copy from your hand by paying {4}{W}.
Sunbird's Invocation triggers.
In response, activate Hidden Retreat by putting Approach of the Second Sun on top of your library, preventing all damage that would be dealt by the copy of Approach of the Second Sun this turn.
Resolve the Sunbird's Invocation trigger, revealing the top seven cards of your library, casting Approach of the Second Sun without paying its mana cost, then putting the rest of the revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Resolve Approach of the Second Sun, putting it back into your library seventh from the top and gaining you 7 life.
Resolve the remaining copy of Approach of the Second Sun.

1722-2034-4616.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Moldervine Reclamation, causing you to gain 1 life and drawing you a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

2593-2882-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2593-2882-4675-4694.description:
Cast Astral Cornucopia by paying {0}.
Astral Cornucopia enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Astral Cornucopia from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
